footer.tagline: From the field to your door — fully transparent. Adopt a share of a real Egyptian farm and follow every step.
footer.builtByText: A portfolio project by the Nabta team — Django, DRF, React & Tailwind. Connecting Egyptian farms directly to households.

landing.heroTitle: From the field to your door —
landing.heroText: Adopt a share of a real Egyptian farm. Follow your tomatoes, olives, eggs or honey through every step of the journey — and cut the waste that happens in the dark.
landing.howSubtitle: Four steps between a seed in the ground and a box at your door.

steps.registerText: Farmers list a crop or animal batch with planting and harvest dates.
steps.adoptText: You claim a share and get a direct line to that specific batch.
steps.trackText: Every stage is scanned via QR — harvest, cold storage, transport, market.
steps.deliverText: Your share arrives at your door with its full, honest journey attached.

landing.consumerTitle: Know exactly where your food came from
consumerPoints: Adopt a share of a specific batch, not a vague label
Watch a live timeline with photos from the farm
See the real loss at each stage — nothing hidden
Support Egyptian farms directly, at a fair price
landing.farmerTitle: Sell before harvest, lose less after it
farmerPoints: Register a batch and get a printable QR label in seconds
Log each stage from your phone — harvest to market
See loss analytics per stage across all your batches
Build a direct relationship with the people who eat your food
landing.problemTitle: The supply chain wastes what farmers grow
landing.problemText: Produce changes hands five or more times before it reaches a plate. At every hop, some is lost — and the shopper never sees any of it.

landing.featuredSubtitle: Adopt a share before it's picked.
landing.ctaText: Create a free account as a consumer or a farmer and see the whole journey — nothing hidden.

farmers.title: Sell before harvest.
farmers.text: Nabta connects your farm directly to households in Cairo and beyond. Register your batches, track them by QR, and let people adopt a share before you've even picked.

features.registerTitle: Register a batch in under a minute
features.registerText: Crop type, quantity, planting and harvest dates. We generate a unique QR code you can print and stick on every crate.
features.logTitle: Log every stage from your phone
features.logText: Scan the batch QR, pick the stage, enter how much is good vs damaged. That's it — the timeline updates for every adopter.
features.lossText: A simple per-stage loss breakdown across all your batches, so you know whether the problem is the field, the store, or the road.

farmers.needSubtitle: No hardware, no integration. Just a phone.
needPoints: Your batch details — crop, quantity, dates
A printer for the QR labels (or just save the image)
Two minutes per stage to log an update
